Yasin Malik named in chargesheet for 1990 nurse murder case

Jammu and Kashmir's State Investigation Agency has filed a chargesheet naming Yasin Malik and four other JKLF operatives in the 1990 abduction and killing of Kashmiri Pandit nurse Sarla Bhat. The chargesheet, filed 36 years after the incident, details the planning and execution of the crime. The case involves allegations of terrorism and murder, with Malik identified as a principal figure.
